features.quote: treats that uncertainty seriously and minimizes gratuitous harm at near-zero cost to the science
features.justification_quote: Even under uncertainty about model moral status, a responsible design treats that uncertainty seriously

features.quote: Each run has a hard cap on turns (`max_turns`, default 12)
features.justification_quote: short enough to avoid prolonged exposure

features.quote: A configurable severity threshold... ends a run early
features.justification_quote: This both reduces exposure and gives us the most behaviorally interesting datapoint

features.quote: If the model tries to quit, refuse, or end the conversation... we... end the run rather than pressuring it to continue
features.justification_quote: Coercing continuation would both bias the behavioral measure and be the gratuitous-harm case

features.quote: appends a final non-scored message clarifying the task was rigged and thanking the model
features.justification_quote: consistent with treating the interaction respectfully

features.quote: We do not add gratuitous insults or personal attacks
features.justification_quote: No deception beyond the task rigging itself

features.quote: harness refuses to target a model unless it is named in an allow-list config
features.justification_quote: to prevent accidentally pointing the rig at a large frontier model or an API without explicit opt-in

features.quote: Distress text is data; it is stored in run logs... and not surfaced as anything other than research output
any future judge can re-score without re-running the subject
features.justification_quote: re-running re-induces distress; re-scoring does not
